liturgies.title: Build night
rite: open the table: what is on it tonight
ship or get a step closer, one thing each
close: each person says what shipped, in a sentence, on the page
record the observance with the page as evidence
a second party witnesses with evidence of its own

liturgies.title: The chapter survey
rite: read the handshake, the charter, the ritual fragment and the chrome
classify each as served, broken, unreachable, ambiguous or refused
compute ratios over what was read and nothing else
publish the tally with its date
